core_obligations: Factor the morphism through the fibre product of the source with the target over the base (proof line 8924).
Use the section of the first factor to obtain an equivalence of categories of descent data (proof lines 8925-8927).
Use that the second factor is surjective and flat to obtain faithfulness, and combine (proof lines 8928-8929).
proof_roadmap: The factor with a section (proof lines 8925-8927).
difficulty_reason: For a morphism f: X to X' over S with X surjective and flat over S, the lemma shows that the pullback functor on descent data from X' over S to X over S is faithful (statement lines 8914-8921). The proof factors the morphism through the fibre product of X with X' over S, uses that the first factor has a section and hence induces an equivalence of the categories of descent data, and that the second factor is surjective and flat and hence induces a faithful functor (proof lines 8923-8929). The claim is H2: the same factorization device as the fpqc case, with each factor routed to the statement that applies to it, and both routings stated by the author.
